head: 54486a059cd2032042189bb565646ba4e0f6bd61
title: A backup code with any non-empty totpCode logs in without checking the password or the TOTP.
reason: Line 121 skips the password check whenever totpCode is non-empty, and the backup-code branch at line 131 runs before the TOTP check and never verifies either, so email + any totpCode + one backup code is enough to log in.

head: 54486a059cd2032042189bb565646ba4e0f6bd61
title: Closing the dialog on the backup-codes step leaves 2FA enabled but the UI unaware.
reason: two-factor-auth.tsx:64 only toggles enableModalOpen when the dialog closes by Escape or outside click, so onEnable() never runs and step stays at DisplayBackupCodes, even though the server already enabled 2FA.

head: 54486a059cd2032042189bb565646ba4e0f6bd61
title: First 2FA test never dismisses the new backup-codes screen and relies on an assertion that always passes.
reason: The weak isChecked assertion was already there, the author flagged it with a FIXME, and the later login step checks that 2FA really is enabled, so this is a test-quality remark.

head: 54486a059cd2032042189bb565646ba4e0f6bd61
title: A backup code is used up with an unguarded read-then-write, so two parallel logins can both use it.
reason: Lines 139-156 decrypt the codes read earlier and write the list back with an unconditional update, so two concurrent requests with the same code can both succeed.

head: 54486a059cd2032042189bb565646ba4e0f6bd61
title: Shared PasswordField toggle removed from the keyboard tab order.
reason: Commit 663530d ("make password visible tooltip non-tabbable") shows the author changed the shared component on purpose.

head: 54486a059cd2032042189bb565646ba4e0f6bd61
title: Passing `type="password"` to PasswordField breaks its show/hide toggle.
reason: In PasswordField, `{...props}` comes after `type={isPasswordVisible ? "text" : "password"}`, so the explicit type="password" at line 176 overrides it and the show/hide toggle does nothing.

head: 54486a059cd2032042189bb565646ba4e0f6bd61
title: The copied toast shows even when the clipboard write fails.
reason: Every other clipboard copy in the repo (EventTypeSingleLayout, ApiKeyDialogForm, etc.) calls navigator.clipboard.writeText without awaiting it, so this follows the project's convention.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: minimumTokenResponseSchema uses bogus computed keys, so sync-mode parsing removes every field except access_token.
reason: Lines 8 and 10 use computed keys `[z.string().toString()]`, which both evaluate to "[object Object]", so zod's default stripping removes expiry fields in sync mode.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: In sync mode the fetch Response has no `.data`, so Google token refresh crashes.
reason: In sync mode, refreshOAuthTokens line 15 returns a raw fetch Response, so `res?.data` on line 94 is undefined and `token.access_token` throws.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: Google credential key is overwritten with the SafeParseResult wrapper instead of the token data.
reason: parseRefreshTokenResponse returns the safeParse result (line 29), and line 97 writes that `{success,data}` object to credential.key.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: In sync mode HubSpot treats the raw fetch Response as a token and saves it as the credential key.
reason: In sync mode refreshOAuthTokens returns a fetch Response, so `expiresIn` is undefined, and line 198 saves the Response object as the key.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: Salesforce refreshes on every client build, throws on an empty statusText, and never uses the new token.
reason: getClient refreshes on every construction, builds the Connection from the old `credentialKey.access_token` (line 106), and calls `prisma` with no import.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: Zoho Bigin passes the credential id where `refreshOAuthTokens` expects the user id.
reason: Line 93 passes `credentialId` (credential.id), which refreshOAuthTokens sends to the sync endpoint as calcomUserId.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: A placeholder "refresh_token" can overwrite the real stored refresh token.
reason: The Office refreshTokenResponseSchema has `refresh_token: z.string().optional()`, so a response without it gets the placeholder, which is spread over the stored credentials on line 264.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: The webhook secret is compared with plain `!==`, which leaks timing.
reason: Line 25 uses a plain `!==`, and if CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset, a request without the header matches (undefined === undefined) and gets through.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: The sync request is unauthenticated and its HTTP status is never checked.
reason: refreshOAuthTokens lines 8-14 send no authentication to the sync endpoint and return the response without checking `response.ok`.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: An invalid Office 365 token response now throws, and the merge can still store the SafeParseResult.
reason: Throwing on an invalid token response instead of saving a merged, unchanged credential is a deliberate behaviour choice; the substantive schema problem is already covered by finding 0.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: Bad bodies and failed decryption surface as unhandled 500s.
reason: Line 31 uses `.parse`, and lines 57-59 run JSON.parse/symmetricDecrypt with no try/catch, so bad input surfaces as an unhandled 500.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: The redirect URI was hardcoded instead of using `appConfig.slug`, which the request does not cover.
reason: The hardcoded path "zoho-bigin" matches the app's slug and integrationName, so nothing breaks; this is a style remark.

head: c790227e0cda780e6fea9bb03af27948d9e286b9
title: The retry-count delete ignores the method, so it removes reminders of every type, not just SMS.
reason: Only scheduleSMSReminders.ts (lines 184/195) ever increments retryCount on workflowReminder, so non-SMS reminders can never reach retryCount > 1; the finding itself admits other types are safe today and only describes a hypothetical future change.

head: c790227e0cda780e6fea9bb03af27948d9e286b9
title: A database write inside the catch block can throw and abort the whole cron run.
reason: The new unguarded prisma.workflowReminder.update in the catch block (lines 190-197) throws P2025 if the row was deleted mid-run (or on DB errors), escaping the for-loop and aborting the remaining reminders, where previously the catch only logged.

head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
title: `sed -i ''` only works with BSD/macOS sed and fails on Linux.
reason: Line 68 `sed -i '' -E "s|...|"` makes GNU sed take '' as the script and the substitution as a filename, so it fails on Linux while the script still prints "✅ Updated".

head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
title: The dev:cron runner was swapped from ts-node to tsx, which the request does not cover.
reason: The dev:cron runner swap is a remark about scope (its own commit a8747ea), not a defect.

head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
title: Existing cache rows get the migration time as `updatedAt`, so old caches look freshly updated.
reason: Commit 5fd11f9 says the NOW() default is deliberate, so existing rows get a valid timestamp, and cache rows are short-lived and rewritten on refresh.

head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
title: ENV_FILE is resolved against the current directory, not the script's location.
reason: `ENV_FILE="../.env"` resolves against the current directory, so running the script from the repo root creates or edits a .env outside the repository.

head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
title: The cache timestamp is always formatted with the "en-US" locale.
reason: Lines 89-92 hardcode `new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", ...)`, so the timestamp ignores the user's locale even though the rest of the text is localised.

head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
title: Failures exit with status 0.
reason: `cleanup` always calls `exit 0`, and it also runs on the rate-limit and failed-URL error paths, so failures report success.

head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
title: Access denial throws a plain Error, which tRPC reports as a 500.
reason: deleteCache.handler.ts line 25 throws a plain `Error`, which tRPC maps to INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR (500) instead of NOT_FOUND.

head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
title: updateMany with empty data may not bump updatedAt, and it adds a write on every cache refresh.
reason: Whether `updateMany(..., data: {})` bumps `@updatedAt` depends on the Prisma version's empty-update behaviour, which I couldn't verify; the extra write was intended per commit 08762ca.

head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
title: The database default may not match the Prisma schema, which would cause migration drift.
reason: schema.prisma line 1719 declares `updatedAt DateTime @default(now()) @updatedAt`, which matches the migration's DEFAULT NOW().

head: 820d7fa87e0c824c5dee8082a33efadb1a2566f7
title: `import()` runs as soon as the module loads, so no app loading is deferred.
reason: Each `appStore` property at index.ts lines 3-30 is an `import("./x")` call, which starts loading as soon as the module is evaluated, so importing `appStore` (as getCalendar.ts does) still loads every app up front.

head: 820d7fa87e0c824c5dee8082a33efadb1a2566f7
title: The async `forEach` callback moves `getCalendar` errors outside the try/catch.
reason: getCalendar is now async (getCalendar.ts:9) and can reject from the awaited appStore entry or `new CalendarService(credential)`, so inside `forEach(async ...)` at reschedule.ts:125 that error escapes the try/catch that used to log it.

head: 820d7fa87e0c824c5dee8082a33efadb1a2566f7
title: The async `forEach` callback moves `getCalendar` errors outside the try/catch.
reason: Same as vital: the `forEach(async ...)` at wipemycalother reschedule.ts:125 throws away the promise of the now-async getCalendar, so its errors leave the surrounding try/catch as unhandled rejections.

head: 820d7fa87e0c824c5dee8082a33efadb1a2566f7
title: The async `forEach` callback drops the promises, and rejections go unhandled.
reason: At bookings.tsx:553 a getCalendar error used to be a synchronous throw that failed the request; with `forEach(async ...)` and `await getCalendar` it becomes an unhandled rejection.

head: ffbaf8c54269df2ce510de91245760fddce09896
title: Second `downsize` definition silently replaces the 5-argument one.
reason: The second `def self.downsize(from, to, dimensions, opts={})` replaces the 5-argument one, and app/jobs/regular/resize_emoji.rb:14 still calls `downsize(path, path, 100, 100, opts)` with five arguments, which raises ArgumentError.

head: ffbaf8c54269df2ce510de91245760fddce09896
title: Client size check is now a fixed 10 MB for every upload type.
reason: utilities.js:182 now applies `10 * 1024` to every file type, so sites whose max_attachment_size_kb is above 10 MB will have attachments rejected in the browser, and attachments are never downsized on the server.

head: ffbaf8c54269df2ce510de91245760fddce09896
title: Hardcoded 10 MB cap ignores the configured size settings.
reason: uploads_controller.rb:55 replaces the site-setting limit with a hardcoded `10.megabytes`, so API URL uploads that a higher configured limit allows are now rejected.

head: ffbaf8c54269df2ce510de91245760fddce09896
title: The downsize loop ignores failures and may leave `tempfile` reading stale content.
reason: The return value of `OptimizedImage.downsize` at line 67 is ignored, so a failing convert is retried five times and the oversized original is uploaded anyway; image_optim (0.20.2 pinned) swaps the file in by rename, so `tempfile.size` can stay stale.

head: ffbaf8c54269df2ce510de91245760fddce09896
title: Animated GIFs are never detected because the tempfile path has no .gif extension.
reason: optimize picks the animated path only when `from =~ /\.GIF$/i` on tempfile.path, and Rack 1.5.5 multipart temp files most likely have no extension; when it does match (FileHelper.download keeps the extension), "80%" is passed to gifsicle's --resize-fit.

head: ffbaf8c54269df2ce510de91245760fddce09896
title: The 413 error message always reports 10 MB.
reason: This concerns the wording of the 413 alert text; the old message showed max_image_size_kb, which was not the web server's limit either, so it is a remark rather than a defect.

head: 6669a2d94d76eea3b99b8c476d12b1eb66726b07
title: Unsubscribe crashes when the user has no TopicUser row or the row has a NULL notification level.
reason: PostAlerter uses `TopicUser.get(...).try(:notification_level)`, so a mentioned user can have no TopicUser row; `find_by` then returns nil and `tu.notification_level` on line 107 raises (the NULL part is wrong because the column is `not null`, but the missing-row crash holds).

head: 6669a2d94d76eea3b99b8c476d12b1eb66726b07
title: The shared `unsubscribe_link` string now needs `%{unsubscribe_url}`, which emails other than notifications do not pass.
reason: Only user_notifications.rb:294 sets `add_unsubscribe_link: true`, and line 295 passes `unsubscribe_url`; the digest uses a different key and the rejection mailer forbids the option, so no email lacks the value.

head: 6669a2d94d76eea3b99b8c476d12b1eb66726b07
title: A state-changing GET lowers the level again on every hit, so a reload or link prefetch mutes the topic.
reason: Lines 107-113 lower the level one step on every GET (regular goes to muted), so a reload or a link prefetch silently mutes the topic.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: Anonymous visitors can make the forum fetch pages and create a topic for any URL on the embeddable host.
reason: TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently? keys the throttle on the exact `retrieved:#{@embed_url}` string and invalid_host? only checks the host, so each query-string variant on the embeddable host fetches the page and creates a new topic.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: Remote and feed HTML is stored as raw_html and served unsanitised on the forum origin.
reason: Post#cook returns raw unchanged for raw_html (post.rb:133), and best.html.erb renders `raw post.cooked`. Readability's whitelist still allows href, and topic_embed.rb:13 puts the URL into `href='#{url}'` without escaping.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: Protocol-relative URLs are rewritten into broken same-host paths.
reason: Lines 64-65 and 70-71 match any value starting with '/' and strip every leading slash, so `//cdn.example.com/x` becomes `http://host/cdn.example.com/x`.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: The Disqus import loses its `--category` option and the original thread dates, and now fetches every thread over HTTP.
reason: The author's own commit deliberately removes the `--category` option and switches the Disqus import to TopicEmbed.import_remote, so this is an intended design change, not a defect.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: Feed items without a `content` element crash the whole poll.
reason: poll_feed.rb:35 calls `i.content.scrub` without a nil check, so an RSS item that only has <description> raises NoMethodError and stops the loop; the job has retry: false.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: An unrelated, already-shipped migration is changed to `force: true`.
reason: A migration runs only once per database and schema rebuilds load schema.rb, so `force: true` has no effect on a database where the migration already ran.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: `Kernel#open` on a configurable URL can run shell commands.
reason: poll_feed.rb:29 and topic_embed.rb:48 use Kernel#open on a setting or URL value, and Kernel#open runs a shell command when the value starts with '|'. That lets an admin, or a crafted Disqus XML file, run commands on the server.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: The update path crashes when the embed's post no longer exists.
reason: Post includes Trashable, whose default_scope hides deleted posts (lib/trashable.rb:5), so `embed.post` is nil for a deleted post and `PostRevisor.new(nil).revise!` crashes.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: `<%- end if %>` turns the next template output into the condition of the block.
reason: `<%- end if %>` at best.html.erb:6 is a typo that turns the next buffer append into a postfix-if condition, so that output runs out of order and the page only renders correctly by accident.

head: 267d8be1f556ed59639ced396c885bb44586da19
title: `include_website_name` is missing the `?`, so ActiveModel::Serializer never calls it.
reason: Line 153 defines `include_website_name` without the `?`, but ActiveModel::Serializer only checks `include_<attr>?` (the file's own convention, e.g. `include_card_image_badge_id?` at line 161), so the filter is never called and `website_name` is always serialized.

head: 060cda77729cb1c4a827560e09e89a7b22078ba9
title: totalPages counts one page too many when user_count is an exact multiple of limit.
reason: Line 13 `Math.floor(user_count/limit)+1` gives 2 for 50/50, so `showingLast` is false on the real last page and next loads an empty page.

head: 060cda77729cb1c4a827560e09e89a7b22078ba9
title: Public group members page now shows only the first 50 members and has no way to page.
reason: group.js sets `limit: 50` and findMembers sends it, the server now paginates every group, and members.hbs has no paging controls, so groups over 50 members show a cut-off list.

head: 060cda77729cb1c4a827560e09e89a7b22078ba9
title: Public members endpoint accepts any client-supplied limit/offset with no bounds.
reason: Before this change non-automatic groups returned every member with no limit, and automatic groups already took limit/offset unclamped, so an unbounded limit is not new exposure; this is hardening, not a regression.

head: 060cda77729cb1c4a827560e09e89a7b22078ba9
title: Add-members input is never cleared, so adding twice re-adds existing members.
reason: group_user.rb has a UNIQUE index on (group_id,user_id) and `Group#add` does `users.push(user)`, so re-adding an existing member raises and returns a 500, and addMembers in group.js has no failure handler.

head: 060cda77729cb1c4a827560e09e89a7b22078ba9
title: Removing a member through `group.users.delete(id)` skips the model's removal logic and errors on non-members.
reason: GroupUser uses `belongs_to :group, counter_cache: "user_count"` and `Group#remove` destroys records, but `group.users.delete(user_id)` on a has_many :through deletes the join rows without callbacks, so the cached user_count can go stale.

head: 7562f37880367411a62304bcdcdc178bced23906
title: The denial-cache test passes even without the denial cache.
reason: Line 982 sets `"dashboards:uid:dash1": false` despite the comment saying it allows access, so the cached and database paths both deny and the assertion passes without the denial cache.

head: 7562f37880367411a62304bcdcdc178bced23906
title: Denials are cached with no invalidation, so a resource can stay denied after access is granted.
reason: The denial cache uses the same 30s shortCacheTTL as permCache, which already had no invalidation before this PR, so the admin-grant delay is not new; the create-flow trigger is unverified speculation.

head: 7562f37880367411a62304bcdcdc178bced23906
title: An ambiguous denial cache key lets one resource's denial apply to another.
reason: cache.go:31 joins name and parent with `_`, and UIDs can contain `_`, so pairs like (`a_`,`b`) and (`a`,`_b`) collide and one resource's denial is wrongly applied to the other for the TTL.

head: 1cab4143d443c33079566f6ca36931eb8468159f
title: Queries may be template-interpolated twice, applying ad-hoc filters twice.
reason: Loki `runQuery` (datasource.ts:350) calls `super.query`, which calls `applyTemplateVariables(q, request.scopedVars, request.filters)` again at DataSourceWithBackend.ts:185, so the targets interpolated at querySplitting.ts:299 get variables and ad-hoc filters applied twice, and `addLabelToQuery` doesn't remove duplicates.

head: bbd8c507cdf56f6b884373809e0b24abd4a2353d
title: Device tagging now runs synchronously on every anonymous login, without the old timeout or panic recovery.
reason: Making TagDevice synchronous in Authenticate (client.go:44-50) is the deliberate point of commit 566e0a8 'break auth if limit reached'; the latency is a design trade-off, not a defect.

head: bbd8c507cdf56f6b884373809e0b24abd4a2353d
title: Separate count and insert steps let concurrent new devices exceed the limit.
reason: CountDevices (database.go:110) and the INSERT (line 149) run in separate sessions with no transaction or lock, so concurrent new devices at limit-1 can all be inserted.

head: bbd8c507cdf56f6b884373809e0b24abd4a2353d
title: The callback rewrites the captured `args` slice, so a retried session sends a corrupted argument list.
reason: WithDbSession retries the callback via retryer.Retry(ss.retryOnLocks(...)) (sqlstore/session.go:83), and line 84 reassigns the captured args, prepending the query again on each retry.

head: bbd8c507cdf56f6b884373809e0b24abd4a2353d
title: Zero rows affected is treated as 'limit reached', which can deny a device that is already registered.
reason: Grafana's MySQL connection string sets clientFoundRows=true (sqlstore.go:287), so RowsAffected counts matched rows and a no-op update returns 1.

head: bbd8c507cdf56f6b884373809e0b24abd4a2353d
title: The store's constructor now needs a raw `int64` limit, which the wire dependency setup cannot supply if it still uses `ProvideAnonDBStore`.
reason: pkg/server/wire.go:374-375 still lists anonstore.ProvideAnonDBStore and binds AnonStore, but that constructor now needs an int64 nothing provides and no service takes the store through wire any more, so wire generation should fail.

head: e369f24665ec70e1e3700f457d25ef83301d931a
title: Background legacy writes use the request context and get cancelled when the request returns.
reason: Lines 51/110/135/163 derive the goroutine context from the request ctx via WithTimeoutCause, so when the handler returns and net/http cancels the request context the legacy write is cancelled.

head: e369f24665ec70e1e3700f457d25ef83301d931a
title: A failed storage Create is recorded as a legacy duration.
reason: Line 45 calls recordLegacyDuration(true, ...) on a d.Storage.Create failure, so the storage failure lands in the legacy metric.

head: e369f24665ec70e1e3700f457d25ef83301d931a
title: A successful storage Delete records the object name as the metric's kind label.
reason: Line 106 passes `name` instead of options.Kind to recordStorageDuration, mislabelling the metric and adding one label value per object name.

head: e369f24665ec70e1e3700f457d25ef83301d931a
title: A failed storage Update is recorded as a legacy duration.
reason: Line 129 records a d.Storage.Update failure with recordLegacyDuration.

head: e369f24665ec70e1e3700f457d25ef83301d931a
title: Legacy DeleteCollection timing is recorded as a storage duration.
reason: Line 166 records the timing of the legacy DeleteCollection with recordStorageDuration.

head: e369f24665ec70e1e3700f457d25ef83301d931a
title: Legacy write failures are no longer logged.
reason: The goroutines at lines 55-56, 112-113, 139-140 and 165-166 only pass err != nil to a metric; the legacy write errors that the old code logged are now dropped without a trace.

head: e369f24665ec70e1e3700f457d25ef83301d931a
title: Legacy Create reads the same `obj` concurrently with the response path.
reason: The response returns `created` (the object storage returns), not `obj`, so the claimed race with the response encoder rests on unverified guesses about how storage handles `obj`.

head: e369f24665ec70e1e3700f457d25ef83301d931a
title: Legacy Update re-runs the original objInfo instead of writing the object storage produced.
reason: Line 139 passes the raw objInfo to Legacy.Update instead of an updateWrapper holding the storage result (mode 2, line 298, uses the wrapper), so legacy recomputes the update and can conflict with it or diverge.

head: e369f24665ec70e1e3700f457d25ef83301d931a
title: Delete puts the base logger into the context instead of the enriched one.
reason: Line 97 uses klog.NewContext(ctx, d.Log) instead of the enriched `log` built on line 96, unlike every other method.

head: e369f24665ec70e1e3700f457d25ef83301d931a
title: Delete no longer reaches legacy when unified storage returns NotFound.
reason: In mode 3 unified storage is the source of truth, so returning early on a storage NotFound fits the stated design (reads and writes centered on unified storage); I judged this intended rather than a defect.

head: e369f24665ec70e1e3700f457d25ef83301d931a
title: Mode 3 integration tests may be flaky because legacy writes are asynchronous.
reason: doPlaylistTests (lines 371-453) writes via /api/playlists, which with FlagKubernetesPlaylists goes through the k8s dual writer, and reads back via the k8s client from unified storage, so it never reads legacy right after an async write.

head: 3214b188de808fdb0fff335556b686f1b0a63218
title: The new `user != null` check turns off passkeys on the normal login page.
reason: isConditionalPasskeysEnabled at line 161 requires `user != null`, so the fresh-login path (no user) at lines 115/137 no longer calls fillContextForm, which drops conditional passkeys from the normal login page.

head: 3214b188de808fdb0fff335556b686f1b0a63218
title: `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()` is called without an argument, but the only version shown takes a `UserModel`.
reason: UsernameForm.java:47 calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() with no arguments, and a repo search shows only the one-parameter isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel) at UsernamePasswordForm.java:160, so the code does not compile.

head: 3214b188de808fdb0fff335556b686f1b0a63218
title: During re-authentication the passkey prompt no longer limits which credentials are allowed, so a different user's passkey could be accepted.
reason: WebAuthnAuthenticator.java:201-209 already compares the authenticated user with context.getUser() and fails with WEBAUTHN_ERROR_DIFFERENT_USER, so another user's passkey cannot switch the session.

head: 79d11c4890cc4792e3dc3535af59e4e5f7a2739d
title: Removing the multiple-provider error lets a FIPS setup silently run on a non-FIPS provider.
reason: Order-based selection is the stated design (approach 2), and the server selects FIPS vs default explicitly via CryptoIntegration.setProvider in KeycloakRecorder.java:214, not via classpath detection.

head: 79d11c4890cc4792e3dc3535af59e4e5f7a2739d
title: Adding `order()` as an abstract method breaks every existing CryptoProvider implementation.
reason: Every CryptoProvider implementation in the repo (Default, FIPS1402 (and its Strict subclass), WildFlyElytron, AuthzClient) gets order(), so nothing in-repo breaks; making it required is the chosen API design.

head: 79d11c4890cc4792e3dc3535af59e4e5f7a2739d
title: Two ASN.1 encoders are built and thrown away.
reason: Lines 114-115 build encoders whose results are discarded; the return statement builds both again, so this is real dead work.

head: 79d11c4890cc4792e3dc3535af59e4e5f7a2739d
title: The ES384 and ES512 tests sign with a P-256 key, so they never test those curves' sizes.
reason: This is a test-coverage suggestion rather than a defect, and its premise that the default curve is P-256 depends on the JDK version.

head: 62bf98939eda58f0d0a1a41a58aa6d4ecdc24dba
title: Exit code 4 changes meaning from "recreate required" to "feature disabled".
reason: The renumbering is deliberate: the comment at lines 31-33 says it avoids picocli's codes 1 and 2, and it came in the 'feedback' commit. Searching the repository shows no operator code that reads these exit codes, so the misreading the finding worries about has no caller in this code.

head: 02f48f776f43734d1ac8914d3ad6a7115acdcb33
title: Lithuanian totpStep1 replaced with an Italian sentence.
reason: Line 101 of the Lithuanian account bundle is now the Italian sentence "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:", so Lithuanian users see Italian.

head: 02f48f776f43734d1ac8914d3ad6a7115acdcb33
title: Simplified Chinese bundle now has a Traditional Chinese string.
reason: Line 112 of messages_zh_CN.properties uses Traditional characters (手機, 應用程式) while the lines around it, such as line 111 "手机", are Simplified.

head: 02f48f776f43734d1ac8914d3ad6a7115acdcb33
title: Lithuanian loginTotpStep1 replaced with an Italian sentence.
reason: Line 71 of the Lithuanian login bundle, loginTotpStep1, is now the Italian sentence "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:".

head: 02f48f776f43734d1ac8914d3ad6a7115acdcb33
title: Account UI message switched from i18next `{{0}}` placeholders to MessageFormat syntax.
reason: account-ui/src/i18n.ts uses i18next's default {{}} interpolation on raw values loaded from the server, and setUserProfileServerError passes the error params to t(); i18next will not fill {0} or {2,choice,...}, while every other error key in the file keeps {{0}}.

head: 02f48f776f43734d1ac8914d3ad6a7115acdcb33
title: Admin UI message switched from i18next `{{0}}` placeholders to MessageFormat syntax.
reason: The admin UI translates these error keys client-side with i18next, as the {{0}} syntax in the file's other error keys (lines 2989-2997) shows; no server-side conversion exists, so the MessageFormat placeholders and choice pattern will appear literally.

head: 8ab88145113dd23a930e23b9cbbcf8b30e4c0b17
title: OptimizedCursorPaginator applies numeric math to the `datetime` key, so the optimized path crashes.
reason: Line 840 calls math.floor/math.ceil on getattr(item, 'datetime'), which is a datetime object, so it raises TypeError. Line 843 returns the raw number, where DateTimePaginator (lines 233-241) converts the value to a datetime first.

head: 8ab88145113dd23a930e23b9cbbcf8b30e4c0b17
title: Negative offsets from the client are passed straight into a Django queryset slice, which raises an error.
reason: Cursor.__init__ only does int(offset) with no sign check (utils/cursors.py:28). With a negative offset, line 882 slices the queryset with a negative start, which Django rejects with an error ('Negative indexing is not supported').

head: 8ab88145113dd23a930e23b9cbbcf8b30e4c0b17
title: The admin check is wrong, and it runs on every request even when the optimized path is not requested.
reason: RpcUserOrganizationContext.member is typed `RpcOrganizationMember | None` (model.py:346). Line 71 reads `.member.has_global_access` on every request, before use_optimized is checked, so a caller that is not a superuser and has no membership (e.g. a token or staff request) gets an AttributeError, even on the normal listing path.

head: 8ab88145113dd23a930e23b9cbbcf8b30e4c0b17
title: The shared BasePaginator still passes negative offsets through for prev cursors.
reason: Before this change the code did `queryset[offset:stop]` with no clamping in either direction, so negative prev offsets already passed through. Line 182 only adds clamping for next cursors and does not make the prev case any worse.

head: ce2dcc537b4b1f98a335e88cfe8e0b804483252a
title: A credential from user storage can now be passed to `removeStoredCredentialById`, which only works on the local store.
reason: RecoveryAuthnCodesUtils.getCredential returns the user-storage credential first, but removeStoredCredentialById (UserCredentialManager.java:116) only deletes from Keycloak's own store, so the used-up credential stays in user storage.

head: ce2dcc537b4b1f98a335e88cfe8e0b804483252a
title: `getCredentials` throws a NullPointerException when the user is not in the provider's map.
reason: The new getCredentials dereferences myUser.recoveryCodes without the null check that isConfiguredFor and getDisableableCredentialTypesStream do, and getMyUser can return null after removeUser takes the user out of the map.

head: bb75657fc8f13923c1d7983f422290908a1e7310
title: Accessing `metadata["sender"]["login"]` directly crashes when the integration has no sender
reason: build_integration only sets metadata['sender'] when state.get('sender') (line 376), and the pipeline never binds sender, so pipeline-created or older Integrations lack it and line 503 raises KeyError on re-install.

head: bb75657fc8f13923c1d7983f422290908a1e7310
title: `test_installation_not_found` no longer tests the 404 path
reason: The rewritten test sends a mismatched state without starting the pipeline, so it hits the state-mismatch error in OAuthLoginView and no longer exercises the 404 'installation could not be found' path.

head: bb75657fc8f13923c1d7983f422290908a1e7310
title: Network and API failures in the token exchange and user lookup cause a 500
reason: safe_urlopen at line 423 is outside the try, and get_user_info calls resp.raise_for_status() without any handler, so network or API errors escape the view as a 500.

head: bb75657fc8f13923c1d7983f422290908a1e7310
title: OAuth authorize URL query parameters are not URL-encoded
reason: redirect_uri is absolute_uri(reverse('sentry-extension-setup')), a fixed path without ?, & or #, so the query cannot break in practice; this is a style point.

head: 6ad6fe3899f630ccf922ce7ac681147dc7987435
title: upsampled_count() counts events with no sample_weight as 0.
reason: discover.py:1048 uses sum(Column("sample_weight")) with no ifNull, so NULL weights contribute nothing; the commit removed the null handling and nothing shown guarantees the column is set.

head: 6ad6fe3899f630ccf922ce7ac681147dc7987435
title: An unrelated submodule gitlink `sentry-repo` was committed.
reason: The new gitlink `sentry-repo` points to an unrelated OTLP span-links commit and is unrelated to the upsampling change.

head: 6ad6fe3899f630ccf922ce7ac681147dc7987435
title: The substring check treats negated or mixed queries as error-only.
reason: Line 137 `"event.type:error" in query` also matches `!event.type:error` and OR'd queries, which turns on upsampled_count for non-error rows.

head: 6ad6fe3899f630ccf922ce7ac681147dc7987435
title: The eligibility check uses the outer `dataset` instead of `scoped_dataset`.
reason: The split paths (lines 344-399) run only when metrics_enhanced is true, so the outer `dataset` is a metrics dataset and _should_apply_sample_weight_transform returns False; the described transactions-with-upsampling case cannot occur.

head: 6ad6fe3899f630ccf922ce7ac681147dc7987435
title: Allowlist changes can take up to 60 seconds to apply, and nothing invalidates the cache.
reason: The docstring and commit say a 60s cache with eventual consistency is acceptable for infrequent allowlist changes, so this is an intended design choice, not a defect.

head: 3162ad68a5c87666788b27a44eb31235025091a9
title: A hung flusher process is no longer killed before its replacement starts.
reason: Line 254 checks isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process), but the processes come from the spawn context and SpawnProcess subclasses BaseProcess, not multiprocessing.Process, so kill() never runs on a hung process before its replacement starts.

head: 3162ad68a5c87666788b27a44eb31235025091a9
title: The added `time.sleep(0.1)` does nothing because the test replaces `time.sleep` with a no-op.
reason: Line 15 patches time.sleep to a no-op, so the new time.sleep(0.1) at line 62 does nothing, and join() (line 331) sets stopped immediately, so the race remains.

head: 3162ad68a5c87666788b27a44eb31235025091a9
title: The `wait_produce` metric uses the tag key `shards`; the other new metrics use `shard`.
reason: Line 199 uses the tag key 'shards' while lines 185 and 195 use 'shard', so queries that filter on 'shard' miss the wait_produce metric.

head: 8422030ef456e3a898415e96475b4d8ddfc7640f
title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now abstract, so building it raises TypeError.
reason: StatefulDetectorHandler declares abstract counter_names/get_dedupe_value/get_group_key_values/build_occurrence_and_event_data (detector.py 142-170), the subclass is only `pass`, and grouptype.py line 27 wires it as MetricAlertFire.detector_handler, so creating it raises TypeError where it used to return [].

head: 8422030ef456e3a898415e96475b4d8ddfc7640f
title: The expected occurrence is built for group key "val1", but the test evaluates "group_key".
reason: IssueOccurrence.__eq__ compares only `self.id` (issue_occurrence.py 181-184), and the mock uses a hardcoded id, so the different fingerprint does not make the assertion at line 559 fail.
